2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Kansas City watches its left tackle while Denver arrives with a nearly clean report
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Broncos list only Marvin Mims Jr. on their report and he was a full participant, while the Chiefs had Josh Simmons and Chamarri Conner miss Friday’s work. Patrick Mahomes and most other listed Kansas City players practiced fully, with Chris Jones limited. Denver’s path is obvious: test the Chiefs’ left-side protection before Kansas City can settle into its normal sequencing. The Chiefs can counter with tempo, quick distribution and formation changes that make Denver reveal pressure before the snap.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City can blunt Denver’s pass-rush advantage with fast answers and pre-snap manipulation, keeping the offense functional even if protection availability remains unsettled.
